name: calendario-movil
description: Empaquetado Android/iOS de Calendarios MAP — Desarrollado por Marco Antonio Posligua San Martín

scripts.cap:android: node -e "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('android')?0:1)" && cap sync android || cap add android
scripts.cap:ios: node -e "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('ios')?0:1)" && cap sync ios || cap add ios
scripts.apk:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.apk:debug:win: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release:win: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
